title: Pizza Connection 3 / Barro's Pizza Creator + Workbench + Runtime Proof Studio completion contract

truth_policy.rule: A gate is PASS only when the named command, runtime observation, repository state, or screenshot exists and the evidence is retained. Source presence, mockups, plans, assumptions, generated promotional images, or documentation alone never prove runtime behavior.
truth_policy.promotion: The ecosystem may be called 100% complete only when every release_required gate is PASS. BLOCKED and NOT_RUN are not completion.
truth_policy.snapshot_rule: Visual gates require retained screenshots from the actual running application or game. Reference mockups may be compared with them but may not substitute for them.
truth_policy.publication_rule: A repository publication gate passes only after the remote reports the expected commit SHA on the intended branch.
truth_policy.technical_identity_rule: User-facing branding may say Pizza Connection 3 / Barro's Pizza, but compatibility identifiers including Pizza Connection 3.exe, build-native Data folder names, Assembly-CSharp.dll, Unity scene/object IDs, PathIDs and verified hashes must not be renamed for branding.
truth_policy.build_routing_rule: Creator 0.11.272 / Unity 2017.3.1p4 and Studio 1.11.403 / Unity 2017.4.40f1 are separate certified runtime profiles. Shared asset logic does not make their assemblies, PathIDs, scenes or runtime evidence interchangeable.
truth_policy.attachment_rule: Visual attachments are accepted by decoded bytes, not filename extension. PNG/JPEG/WebP magic structure, dimensions, declared MIME and configured size/count limits must validate before provider use.
